turns.text: Things with Tom are great! We actually managed to grab a quick dinner together yesterday evening before I had to sleep. It was nice to catch up.

turns.text: I didn't have time to pack anything, so I'll probably just grab a quick bowl of leafy greens and veggies from the hospital cafeteria during my break.

turns.text: Simple and fresh is always a safe bet. Is the spring weather in Phoenix still holding up, or is the desert heat already creeping in?

turns.text: Oh, it's definitely starting to feel pretty warm during the day now, typical Phoenix spring! But at least the evenings are still nice when I head out. I should probably get moving and call that ride now.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Have a safe ride and a smooth, quiet shift tonight, Sofia! Talk to you tomorrow.
